implementation_summary: New checker-fetch.ts: makeCheckerFetch(opts) builds the checkers' FetchFn on makeOutboundFetch (GET only, pinned, every hop re-checked, maxRedirects 0 by default, 3 s timeout, 512 KB cap; allowPrivate only narrows, a browser guard means public only). checkLinkStatus(address, fetchFn) sends one GET and fails on 404/410/500-599 or no answer. The orchestrator builds checkerFetch once per run and passes it to securityDepth.checkPage and seoChecker.checkPage; the check-link step uses linkFetch (makeCheckerFetch maxRedirects 10, 10 s). This removes page.request.get and closes F-001. security-depth.ts: defaultFetch and its fallbacks removed; checkSourceMaps requires a FetchFn; with no FetchFn checkPage makes no request and reports 'security.txt was not checked' and 'Source maps were not checked' once per site (Suggestion, needsConfirmation). seo.ts: checkPage(page, ctx, fetchFn?); checkBrokenLinks sends one GET per link through fetchFn (no HEAD, up to 5); the site-root audit uses the same fetchFn; with none, no request and 'Links were not checked' / 'Site files were not checked' notes. outbound-source-grep.test.ts scans core/src and checkers/src, skipping comment lines, for context.request, page.request, request.fetch/get/head and Node or globalThis fetch( outside a named exception list; stale exceptions also fail.

Orchestrator-level test that a plan check-link step on a guarded run with a link to 169.254.169.254 fails as 'doesn't open' without connecting
evidence: packages/core/src/orchestrator.ts: checkerFetch/linkFetch built next to siteWide; checkLinkStatus(step.value, linkFetch); checkerFetch passed to securityDepth.checkPage and seoChecker.checkPage
packages/checkers/src/security-depth.ts: defaultFetch removed; notChecked(); checkPage branches on fetchFn

packages/core/src/access-control.ts:182-197 contextFetcher now uses makeOutboundFetch (BE-101), which causes the orchestrator-access-wiring failure
blockers: CHK-BE-104-CHECKERS includes packages/core/tests/orchestrator-access-wiring.test.ts (not owned), which fails at :75: it stubs context.request.get, but BE-101's contextFetcher (packages/core/src/access-control.ts) now uses makeOutboundFetch. The test must inject NetDeps; its owner has to update it.
risks: Source-grep exception list adds packages/core/src/audit/store/select-backend.ts (globalThis.fetch for Cloud Storage and metadata, fixed endpoints), which the brief does not name; needed for the current tree to pass. Reviewer should confirm.
checkLinkStatus treats only 500-599 as a server failure; the old code failed every status >= 500, including 999, despite its comment saying 999 passes.
The checker FetchFn uses maxRedirects 0: a site whose /robots.txt or /sitemap.xml redirects could now get a 'missing' site-file finding, and a redirect to a 404 is not caught as a broken link.
Checker and link requests no longer carry browser-context cookies, so signed-in-only targets answer as signed out.
With no FetchFn the checkers add Suggestion/needsConfirmation 'not checked' notes; ADR 0031 currently says such checks 'report nothing' and should be updated.

Exported API change in @qa/checkers: defaultFetch removed; SecurityDepthChecker.checkSourceMaps third argument is now required; SeoChecker.checkPage gains an optional third argument. The only in-repo caller is the orchestrator.
